project_type: React + TypeScript SPA with Vite, TailwindCSS styling, Supabase backend
build_system: Vite - npm scripts: dev (dev server), build (production), build:check (with type checking)
test_framework: No test framework currently configured in project
test_command: npm run build:check (TypeScript checking only, no unit tests)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build:check` to verify TypeScript compilation. 2. Start dev server with `npm run dev` and manually verify in browser at localhost:5173. 3. Test with authenticated user to see dashboard (use admin@safaricom.co.ke / admin123).
environment_constraints: Dev server runs on port 5173. Supabase credentials in .env.local (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY). Authentication required to view dashboard - must be logged in. Project deployed on Vercel.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found in project root. Standard React/TypeScript patterns apply.
key_patterns: 1. Supabase integration via hooks (useTickets, useAuth). 2. Context providers wrap app (AuthProvider, FilterProvider). 3. Lucide React for all icons. 4. TailwindCSS utility classes for styling. 5. Green (#10b981, green-600) as primary brand color per landing page. 6. White backgrounds with subtle shadows/borders. 7. useAuth hook provides: user, profile, isAuthenticated, isAdmin, loading, logout. 8. useTickets hook provides: tickets[], loading, error, refetch, updateTicketStatus. 9. Ticket statuses: 'open', 'pending', 'in-progress', 'closed', 'resolved' - map to CHU equivalents.
relevant_files: src/pages/SEMADashboardComplete.tsx (current file - will be completely replaced)
src/hooks/useTickets.ts (live data hook returning tickets[] with id, status, county, created_at, assigned_to)
src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx (provides useAuth hook with logout function and user info)
src/data/kenyaAdministrative.ts (allCounties array with all 47 counties: id, name, capital, region, population)
src/data/kenyaCountiesData.ts (kenyaCountiesData array with performance data per county)
src/App.tsx (shows how SEMADashboardComplete is mounted after authentication)
directory_structure: src/pages/ - page components; src/hooks/ - custom hooks for data fetching; src/contexts/ - React contexts for auth/state; src/data/ - static data files (counties, mock data); src/components/ - reusable components; src/services/ - API service layers (tickets.service.ts)
